ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the period of the relevant individual's involvement in the Services and for 12 months after the end of that involvement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.

ops.text: The restriction in the preceding sentence is mutual and binds each party equally with respect to the other party's personnel, applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services, and does not apply to unsolicited approaches by any such personnel.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have cut the tail so the restriction runs only during each individual's involvement in the Services and for 12 months after that involvement ends, and added one sentence making it expressly mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, and inapplicable to unsolicited approaches. This is our fallback position; the existing general-advertising carve-out and the "Solicit" definition are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Narrow non-solicit to mutual, personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from end of involvement

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.

mappings.quote: but shall not mean generally advertising job openings
the term "Solicit" means any affirmative recruitment specifically aimed at one or more individuals identified by name, title or affiliation
